name: en-offsite
lines: you
Thanks both. Let's sort out the offsite: the venue, the budget and the agenda.
them
Alice here. I've compared the two venues. Lisbon is cheaper on flights for most of the team, so I'd go with Lisbon.
you
Agreed, Lisbon it is, the flights make the difference.
them
Bob here. I can book the venue, I'll do it by Friday.
you
Great. I'll draft the agenda and share it on Monday.
them
What about catering? Nobody has picked that up yet.
you
Let's leave catering open for now, but someone needs to get quotes this week.
them
Alice again. We also decided to keep it to two days, because people can't be away from their teams any longer.
you
Yes, two days. And we still don't know if the client team wants to join us.

name: fr-salon-lyon
lines: you
Bonjour à tous. On fait le point sur le salon de Lyon : le budget, le traiteur et les chambres.
them
Alice ici. Le devis du traiteur est arrivé hier et il est beaucoup trop cher pour nous.
you
Alors on garde le lieu, mais on change de traiteur, parce que ce devis dépasse le budget.
them
Alice encore. D'accord, je vais demander deux autres devis avant vendredi.
you
Merci Alice. De mon côté, j'envoie le plan de salle à toute l'équipe demain.
them
Karim ici. Et pour les chambres des exposants, qui s'en occupe ? Personne n'a encore réservé.
you
Il faut les réserver cette semaine, mais on n'a pas encore décidé qui le fera.
them
Karim encore. On a aussi décidé de ne pas imprimer de catalogue cette année, parce que tout est en ligne maintenant.
you
Oui, pas de catalogue. Il reste la question des badges pour les visiteurs.

name: es-campana
lines: you
Bueno, empezamos. Hoy toca revisar el lanzamiento de la campaña de primavera.
them
Marta aquí. El diseño está casi listo, pero todavía hay que revisar los textos con el equipo legal.
you
Entonces movemos el lanzamiento al lunes, porque el proveedor no puede imprimir antes.
them
Marta otra vez. Vale, yo hablo con el proveedor esta tarde para confirmar la fecha.
you
Perfecto. Yo preparo el presupuesto para el cliente y lo envío el jueves.
them
Diego aquí. ¿Quién revisa los textos con legal? Todavía no lo tiene nadie.
you
Hay que hacerlo esta semana, pero no hemos decidido quién lo hace.
them
Diego otra vez. También decidimos usar solo redes sociales, porque la radio es demasiado cara.
you
Sí, solo redes. Nos queda pendiente saber si el cliente quiere un vídeo.

name: en-release-first-language-fr
lines: you
Quick sync on the website release. Where are we with the testing?
them
Priya here. Testing is done except the payment page, which still fails on mobile.
you
Then we'll hold the release until Thursday, because we can't ship a broken checkout.
them
Tom here. I'll fix the mobile payment bug by Wednesday.
you
Thanks Tom. I will tell the support team about the new date.
them
Who updates the release notes? Nobody has done that yet.
you
We need someone on the release notes this week, it's still open.
